description: This Java source file implements a Voice Interaction Service for Android, utilizing voice recognition and hotword detection. It manages hotword detection lifecycle, handles recognition events, and interacts with visual query detection components.

classes.description: Binder class enabling clients to bind and interact with the service.

classes.name: SampleVoiceInteractionService.VisualQueryDetectorCallback
classes.description: Callback class handling visual query detection events.

classes.name: SampleVoiceInteractionService.Callback
classes.description: Callback handling hotword detection events and managing recognition states.
